title: Signature 17 · Muscle Hourglass · Celadon Kintsugi · Rainy Greenhouse
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her early 40s, long black waves down her back.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. Muscular hourglass BBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 300 pounds — a gigantic heavy bust, broad rounded strong shoulders, enormous thick arms with big defined biceps, a clearly cinched waist that is narrow only in contrast to the enormous bust and the very wide heavy hips, a firm flat stomach with no visible abs, colossal thighs with powerful defined quads, massive calves. Feminine face, warm smile, not masculine, no bodybuilder look, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body kintsugi painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. Pale celadon ceramic glaze with fine crackle and blazing raised gold repair seams. The gold seams wrap the swell of the biceps and quads and narrow across the cinched waistline. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing in a glamour pose, wide stance with a strong hip shift, arms hanging relaxed slightly away from the body, no flexing.

Footwear: Extremely high platform stiletto mules in translucent iridescent pearl. Nails: extra long stiletto, gold mirror tips.

Background & Lighting: Inside a dark Victorian glass greenhouse on a rainy night, raindrops streaking the dark glass, lush dark leaves in shadow, warm lantern light carving the inward curve of the waist and the swell of the biceps and quads, making every gold seam glow, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss ceramic finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
